question_or_proposition: For Total Dissolved Solids Net Increase, what is the temporal scope during which the numeric effluent limits in the row annotated (*11) govern applicability—including the start boundary stated as '3 year from the permit effective date' and the end boundary stated as permit expiration and any administrative continuation if not reissued prior to expiration—relative to the limits in the row annotated (*10)?
required_context: Footnote *10 and the (*10) TDS Net Increase limit row on page 5 of PART I
The (*11) TDS Net Increase limit row and footnote *11 on page 5 of PART I
Permit effective date, permit expiration date, and whether the permit is administratively continued
SECTION B compliance schedule item 2 (449 mg/L at 3 years after permit effective date) on page 6 of PART I
notes: Footnote *11 schedules when the second TDS Net Increase limit tier applies. Resolving its temporal scope determines whether FY2025 measurements are evaluated against the (*10) or (*11) numeric limits.
